2. Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate for the
respondents.
3. Petitioners have challenged order
dated 03.09.2025 and 07.03.2026, passed
by Second Additional Civil Judge (Senior
Division), Dehradun in O.S. No. 217 of
2013. By the first order dated 03.09.2025,
application filed by plaintiffs/respondents
under Order 22 Rule 4(4) CPC, seeking
exemption from substituting the legal
representatives of defendant no. 2, was
allowed on the ground that proceedings
were continuing ex-parte against
defendant no. 2. Petitioners, thereafter
filed application under Order 1 Rule 10 (2)
CPC seeking impleadment, which was

UKHC010130432026
2026:UHC:7425
rejected by subsequent order dated
07.03.2026.
4. Petitioners have filed a
supplementary affidavit dated 07.08.2026
stating that in the event they are
permitted to be substituted in the suit,
they shall contest the suit from the stage
at which they are substituted and they
shall not challenge any order, passed prior
to date of their substitution.
5. Mr. Piyush Garg, learned counsel
appearing for plaintiff-respondents, on
instructions, submits that he has no
objection if the prayer made by petitioners
for their substitution in the suit is allowed
with the condition that they shall contest
the suit only from the stage at which they
are substituted and they shall not
challenge any order, passed earlier.
6. In view of consensus between the
parties, both the orders, impugned in this
writ petition, passed on 03.09.2025 and
07.03.2026 are hereby set-aside. The writ
petition is allowed and the plaintiffs are
directed to substitute petitioners in the
pending suit and they shall carry out
necessary amendment in the array of
parties, However, it is made clear that
petitioners shall contest the suit only from

UKHC010130432026

the stage they are substituted as legal
representatives and they shall not be at
liberty to challenge the order, if any,
passed in the suit, prior to their
substitution.
7. Ms. Prabha Naithani, learned
counsel for petitioners submits that she is
giving up the contention, as was raised in
para 3 of the supplementary affidavit.
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 18.08.2026
